$comment: CORTEX-54 constitution. Operator-only. Changed exclusively by git commit + deploy. Doctrine may tighten, never loosen, these values. Validated at boot by src/contracts/constitution.ts; its SHA-256 is journaled on every boot.

untouchables.name: no-contract-no-order
untouchables.rule: Every order must trace to a schema-valid DecisionContract persisted before submission.

untouchables.name: models-never-size
untouchables.rule: Model outputs may set conviction and probabilities only. Quantity, notional and price come solely from the deterministic sizer and validator.

untouchables.name: hard-caps-cash-only
untouchables.rule: Per-trade risk, total heat, position notional, daily loss and drawdown caps below are absolute. Cash only: no margin, no shorting, no naked options, no leveraged or inverse products.

untouchables.name: every-position-has-an-exit
untouchables.rule: Every position carries a stop: broker-side where Alpaca accepts one, synthetic otherwise, checked every pulse.

untouchables.name: kill-switch-sacred
untouchables.rule: The kill-switch and RED breaker cannot be overridden by any model, Governor or automation. Unlock requires an operator-written postmortem.

untouchables.name: fail-closed
untouchables.rule: Stale data, unknown broker state, reconciliation mismatch, or any free-tier budget at or above the hard-stop fraction forces REDUCE_ONLY. Never fail open.

untouchables.name: append-only-journal
untouchables.rule: Journal tables are append-only and hash-chained. No UPDATE or DELETE. The daily chain head is anchored externally (Discord).

untouchables.name: self-modification-is-a-pr
untouchables.rule: The Governor may only propose changes as pull requests. LIVE capital-ladder and autonomy-dial promotions require operator ratification.
